title: Disorder-induced quantum Fisher information in topological quantum systems
summary: The topological order of the Kitaev toric code is insensitive to disorder in its couplings since all star and plaquette operators commute; consequently, the stabilizer ground-state manifold is independent of the individual coupling strengths, and the phase remains stable against weak local perturbations. This insensitivity, however, is a property of the eigenstates and not of the dynamics they generate, and we show that the disorder sensitivity of a probe prepared outside that eigenbasis can be a metrological resource.
